about_the_game:
The guy in the mirror is smirking at you... 😏 It’s you, but bolder, reckless, and tired of playing by the rules.

✨ Welcome to Taffy Town ✨

Where one chaotic night leaves you with a new partner in chaos, your own uninhibited alter ego. He’s got wild ideas about shaking up this quiet city, and he needs you to pull the strings, uncover secrets, and shape this town into your personal playground. 💋

But here’s where it gets interesting: you call the shots. The game presents you with a core choice that defines your entire journey:

❤️ The Main Storyline: Team up with your darker side and use your influence to bend the city to your will. Work the social scene, get inside people’s heads, and create the world you desire.

🖤 The Alternative Path: For those who prefer a story of betrayal, heartbreak, and difficult choices, this separate route awaits. It’s an intentional, optional storyline that you’ll only encounter if you choose it.

💡 Important: The alternative storyline is 100% optional and is never triggered by accident. Choosing this path is a conscious decision made by the player.

🔥 What to expect: 🔥

🧠 Meaningful Choices: Shape the story your way. Will you be the mastermind or the observer of unfolding drama? Your call.

🏙️ A City of Temptation: Meet a diverse cast of characters, each with secrets and desires to uncover.

💋 Mature Storytelling: A narrative for adults that explores relationships, power, and intimacy.

😏 Your Unhinged Partner: Banter with a witty alter ego who always has a sarcastic comment or a devious suggestion.

Taffy Town is your sandbox. How will you choose to play?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is intended for adults only and contains explicit content. It includes:

• Frequent scenes of explicit sex between consenting adult characters.
• Depictions of full frontal male and female nudity, including genitalia.
• Storylines and dialogue that deal with mature and complex themes.
• Use of strong language.

All characters depicted in sexual situations are over the age of 18.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan compatible card
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires up-to-date graphics drivers. Game runs on Steam Deck.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.5+ or Vulkan compatible card
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires up-to-date graphics drivers.
